title: Training LLMs Beyond Next Token Prediction - Filling the Mutual Information Gap
abstract: arXiv:2511.00198v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Autoregressive language models are usually trained with next-token prediction under a fixed left-to-right target order. This paper studies target-token organization as a training-time design choice across arithmetic reasoning, multi-label text classification, and text generation. Controlled order studies show that the default NTP order can be far from the best-performing tested organization, while fixed hand-crafted orders such as reverse order do not generalize across tasks. To address this, Max(MI(S;t)) is introduced as a deterministic mutual-information-based heuristic that prioritizes information-rich target tokens. For fixed-length outputs, it constructs task-specific prediction orders; for open-vocabulary text generation, the same principle is applied through lightweight prefix augmentation. translated_title: 超越下一词元预测训练大语言模型——填补互信息差距
translated_abstract: 自回归语言模型通常在固定的从左到右目标顺序下，通过下一词元预测进行训练。本文将目标词元的组织方式作为一种训练时的设计选择，在算术推理、多标签文本分类和文本生成任务上展开研究。受控的顺序实验表明，默认的下一词元预测顺序可能远逊于测试中表现最好的组织方式，而诸如逆序等固定的人工设计顺序则无法在任务之间泛化。为解决这一问题，本文提出了 Max(MI(S;t))，一种确定性的、基于互信息的启发式方法，用于优先处理信息丰富的目标词元。对于固定长度的输出，该方法构建任务特定的预测顺序；对于开放词表的文本生成，同一原则通过轻量级的前缀增强加以应用。在GPT风格模型以及预训练的Llama/Qwen变体上的实验表明，Max(MI(S;t)) 通常优于标准的下一词元预测和简单方法。（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出基于互信息的确定性启发式方法 Max(MI(S;t))，通过优先排列信息量最大的目标词元来自动构建预测顺序，在算术推理、多标签分类和文本生成任务上通常优于标准的下一词元预测训练。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Max(MI(S;t)), a deterministic mutual-information-based heuristic that reorders target tokens to prioritize information-rich ones, often outperforming standard next-token prediction across arithmetic reasoning, multi-label classification, and text generation tasks.
